claim.quote: In a two-neutrino mixing scheme, a 90% C.L. upper limit of sin2 2θµτ < 4.4 × 10−4 is set for large ∆m2 , improving by a factor 1.5 the previously published CHORUS result.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published in Nucl. Phys. B 793 (2008) 326.

key_value_text.quote: a 90% C.L. upper limit of sin2 2θµτ < 4.4 × 10−4 is set for large ∆m2
key_value_text.value: sin^2(2 theta_mu_tau) < 4.4e-4 at 90 % CL for large delta m^2

name: Final results on nu_mu to nu_tau oscillation from the CHORUS experiment

significance.quote: a 90% C.L. upper limit of sin2 2θµτ < 4.4 × 10−4 is set

summary.plain: The final CHORUS analysis of its 1994-97 data found no sign of muon neutrinos turning into tau neutrinos. For large mass differences the mixing is below about 0.0004 (90 % confidence), 1.5 times tighter than the earlier CHORUS limit.
summary.technical: Final nu_mu -> nu_tau appearance analysis of all CHORUS data (1994-1997) with new emulsion scanning and event reconstruction applied to the 1996-97 events without a muon in the electronic detectors, combined with earlier samples: sin^2(2 theta_mu_tau) < 4.4e-4 at 90 % CL for large delta m^2; improves the previous CHORUS limit by a factor 1.5.

title: Final results on nu_mu to nu_tau oscillation from the CHORUS experiment
why_it_matters: The most stringent tau-neutrino appearance limit from a direct (emulsion) search at a short baseline, closing the programme the experiment was built for; NOMAD set a more stringent limit at large delta m^2.
